regulation: UERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Multi Year Tariff) Regulations, 2024 (the order calls them 'UERC Tariff Regulations, 2024')
note: UERC's interest on working capital and return on equity for a distribution licensee, as the FY2026-27 order for UPCL quotes and applies them — the engine's first rules of a second commission.

rules.title: O&M expenses for one month

clause.regulation: UERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Multi Year Tariff) Regulations, 2024 (the order calls them 'UERC Tariff Regulations, 2024')
clause.excerpt: (2) Distribution a) The Distribution Licensee shall be allowed interest on the estimated level of working capital for the financial year, computed as follows: (i) Operation and maintenance expenses for one month; (ii) Maintenance spares @ 15% of operation and maintenance expenses; plus (iii) Two months equivalent of the expected revenue from sale of electricity at prevailing tariffs; (iv) Capital required to finance such shortfall in collection of current dues as may be allowed by the Commission; minus (v) One month equivalent of cost of power purchased, based on the annual power procurement plan.
